entities.name: Abderrahmane Youssoufi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abderrahmane Youssoufi was a Moroccan politician and human rights lawyer who served as Prime Minister of Morocco from 1998 to 2002, serving under King Hassan II and King Mohammed VI. He was the Secretary General of the Socialist Union of Popular Forces.
